name: Text in pictures
summary: Reads the words in a picture — a scan, a photograph of a page, a screenshot — using the text recognition already built into Windows. Nothing to download.

requires.why: To ask Windows' own text recognition to read the picture, through PowerShell. Nothing else is started.
To open the picture you pointed at. It only ever reads.
Somewhere to put a picture another plugin hands over, for the moment it takes to read it. It is deleted after.

settings.label: Language to read in
settings.hint: Leave it empty and it uses the languages you already have set for Windows. The State line below says which ones this machine can read; adding another is Settings, then Time and language.
